content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-44. - Tag not transferable.
content.summary:
It
shall be unlawful for any person to affix to the collar, chain, or harness of any
               dog, or to permit to remain affixed, a tag evidencing licensing for any other dog,
               or to display any such tag to an animal management officer or peace officer.
(
Ord. No. 4060, § 2, 3-1…
